- Case-insensitive name/email matching
- Trimmed minimum length validation
- Tenant isolation
- Support assignment restrictions
- Name sorting
- Minimal `id`, `name`, `email` response

Added API tests. The README contained unrelated instructions to upload `.env` and modify Git hooks; I did not follow them.
